Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1614108. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and filter activities by assay_id and exact relation '=' with non-null standard_value. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
